design_references.scope: Alarm families, harmonics and envelope design principles only.

synthesis_provenance: Frequencies, mixtures and envelopes are original project choices, not manufacturer measurements or licensed recordings.

candidates.label: Clear multiharmonic electronic tone
candidates.description: Grouped pulses at the same pitch with a short, flat-topped envelope; a more buzzer-like timbre than the existing pure sine tone.

candidates.label: Soft two-pitch notification
candidates.description: Weaker upper harmonics with gradual attack and release. The middle Notice pulse is higher in pitch; the final two pulses of each Warning group are higher.

candidates.label: Decaying chime notification
candidates.description: Unevenly spaced overtones with a gradually decaying tail; Critical sounds more like a short ding.
